question: Should assistant messages expose an on-demand Markdown/plain-text copy menu, or should the existing single-action Markdown copy remain unchanged?
rationale: Source inspection can establish that the option is missing, but it cannot choose the desired interaction or how aggressively Markdown structure should be flattened.

options.title: Add Compact Copy Menu
options.body: Keep Markdown as the primary format and offer Plain text beside it with documented conversion behavior and focused tests.

options.title: Add Browser Preference
options.body: Store a browser-local default copy format while retaining a menu for occasional overrides, at the cost of additional preference UX.

options.title: Keep Markdown Only
options.body: Decline the extra format surface and retain the current predictable source-preserving copy behavior.

recommendation.title: Add Compact Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Keep Markdown as the primary format and offer Plain text beside it with documented conversion behavior and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current behavior, are identified as the repository's product lead in CONTRIBUTING.md, and already reviewed this exact request.
